mapper.sql: s.id, s.uploader_id, u.nickname AS uploader_nickname, s.song_name, s.singer, s.arranger, s.sheet_type, s.difficulty, s.key_signature, s.capo_position, s.tuning, s.status, s.offline_reason, s.offline_by, s.offline_at, s.view_count, s.favorite_count, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.deleted_at

where.if: AND (s.song_name LIKE #{request.keywordLike} ESCAPE '\\' OR s.singer LIKE #{request.keywordLike} ESCAPE '\\' OR s.arranger LIKE #{request.keywordLike} ESCAPE '\\')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM guitar_sheet s INNER JOIN guitar_user u ON u.id = s.uploader_id
ORDER BY
s.favorite_count DESC, s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC s.view_count DESC, s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC
LIMIT #{request.size} OFFSET #{request.offset}
SELECT FROM guitar_sheet s INNER JOIN guitar_user u ON u.id = s.uploader_id WHERE s.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE guitar_sheet SET status = 'OFFLINE', offline_reason = #{reason}, offline_by = #{adminUserId}, offline_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE guitar_sheet SET status = 'PUBLISHED', offline_reason = NULL, offline_by = NULL, offline_at = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OFFLINE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
